doc: If the guard flag D_800737C0 is clear, run the one-time RCnt/event setup: sets the guard, opens+enables an interrupt-mode event bound to func_80058510 on hardware timer 0xF2000002, configures and starts that RCnt, then clears the mode flag D_80085F98 and the guard flag D_800737C0 again.

globals.name: D_800737C0
globals.decl: extern s32 D_800737C0[4]; /* scalar guard flag, forced hi/lo via size>8, per repo convention (see D_800737A4 in src/code.c and src/w_8005AE90.c). Confirmed scalar (not struct) by siblings func_800586B0 and func_8005863C which only ever access offset 0. */

globals.name: D_80085F9C
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80085F9C[4]; /* scalar: event handle returned by OpenEvent, later passed to EnableEvent/DisableEvent/CloseEvent (see sibling func_8005863C). offset 0 only. */

globals.name: D_80085F98
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80085F98[4]; /* scalar mode/status flag, offset 0 only, shared with func_8005AE90 and siblings func_800586B0/func_8005863C. */

calls: s32 OpenEvent(u32 class, s32 spec, s32 mode, void (*func)(void))
s32 SetRCnt(u32 spec, u16 target, s32 mode)
func_80058510(void) -- taken as function-address argument to OpenEvent
